title: Localization of a set integral to a good set with a pointwise comparison (abstract measure theory)
statement: Let X be a type (in Lean's lowest universe, Type) with a measurable structure and a measure mu. Let B, B', G, G' be subsets of X, Phi, phi, psi : X -> R, M >= 0 real and m in [0, infinity]. Assume: (1) G and G' are measurable; (2) G' is contained in B and in B'; (3) Phi is mu-integrable on B; (4) |Phi(x)| <= M for every x in X; (5) Phi(x) = 0 for every x in (B \ G') cap G; (6) mu((B \ G') \ G) <= m and m < infinity; (7) phi is a.e. strongly measurable for mu restricted to G'; (8) psi is mu-integrable on B' and psi(x) >= 0 for every x; (9) for mu-a.e. x, x in G' implies |Phi(x) - phi(x)| <= M psi(x). Then |int_{G'} phi dmu| <= |int_B Phi dmu| + M m.toReal + M int_{B'} psi dmu (Bochner set integrals; the proof also shows that phi is mu-integrable on G').
lean_statement: ∀ {X : Type} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (B B' G G' : Set X) (Φ φ ψ : X → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (m : ℝ≥0∞), 0 ≤ M → MeasurableSet G → MeasurableSet G' → G' ⊆ B → G' ⊆ B' → IntegrableOn Φ B μ → (∀ x, |Φ x| ≤ M) → (∀ x ∈ (B \ G') ∩ G, Φ x = 0) → μ ((B \ G') \ G) ≤ m → m < ⊤ → AEStronglyMeasurable φ (μ.restrict G') → IntegrableOn ψ B' μ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ G' → |Φ x - φ x| ≤ M * ψ x) → |∫ x in G', φ x ∂μ| ≤ |∫ x in B, Φ x ∂μ| + M * m.toReal + M * ∫ x in B', ψ x ∂μ
